_how: The University's light show (web/facade-life.js). 'active' is what the room plays; ?facade=<name> tries another. Edit, then restage: uv run --project room python room/tools/restage.py --to <NAME> (about 2 s, no Blender, no bake). Try them side by side: facade-choose.html next to the page. A knob left out takes its default (facade-life.js DEFAULTS, which are v34).

_knobs.mode: 'life' (v34's system), 'sparks' (firecrackers), or a field from the LED panel (layer-ledmatrix.js): 'breathe', 'wave', 'bloom'
_knobs.speed: fields: the field's clock, 0.25-1.5 (1 = lume-machine's own rate)
_knobs.mapping: fields: which coordinate of the index the field reads: 'grid' (the index order), 'cartesian' (x + y), 'polar' (the radius)
_knobs.density: fewer or more lit windows: life scales the reveal, sparks scales every rate (1 = as designed)
_knobs.attack: s, how fast a window lights
_knobs.decay: s, how fast it goes dark again (decay_late: at the build's top)
_knobs.afterglow: life: the ghost trail (v34 1); sparks: an ember after each pop (0 none)
_knobs.warmth: 0 the offices' ~4000 K tubes, 1 the homes' 2700-3000 K
_knobs.rate: sparks: clusters a second over the wall per section; [start, end] across the section (a drop: across its 8-bar groove; drop1 the first drop)
_knobs.crackle: sparks: s between a cluster's pops
_knobs.spread: sparks: cells from the focus where clusters land, [early, at the build's top]
_knobs.pulse: sparks: 30 Hz steps a pop is held at full
_knobs.front: sparks: share of windows that pop as the drop's front passes, [drop 1, drop 2]
_knobs.hum: sparks: the stored charge's faint glow round the focus in a build
_knobs.hold_glow: sparks: the core's glow in the held breath (0: dark and still)
_knobs.interior: 0 a flat lit pane (v34), 1 the full room behind each lit office: its ceiling light, walls, a desk or a shelf; render only, an office that is off stays dark

v34.label: v34, zoals nu
v34.note: Slinger en lading zoals gepubliceerd: banden, wolken, de ingehouden adem.

v34-kalm.label: v34 rustiger
v34-kalm.note: Hetzelfde systeem, minder ramen tegelijk aan, kortere staart.

vonken.label: Vonken (voorstel)
vonken.note: Losse knallen in kleine trossen, donker ertussen; de opbouw trekt ze naar het midden, de adem gloeit zacht, de drop knettert eruit.

vonken-ijl.label: Vonken, ijl
vonken-ijl.note: Nog minder: enkele knallen, geen gloed; de ingehouden adem is gewoon stil en donker.

vonken-adem.label: Vonken + adem
vonken-adem.note: Vonken, met de lading die zichtbaar zoemt in de opbouw en een heldere kern in de ingehouden adem.

knetter.label: Rotje-snoer
knetter.note: Eigen idee: minder trossen, maar elk een snoer van snelle knalletjes langs de gevel.

sintels.label: Sintels
sintels.note: Eigen idee: warmere, zachtere vonken die heel even nagloeien, als sintels uit een vuur.
